comparator.name: Educational Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The full-time Dutch-taught bachelor has 60 EC each year. Introduction to Pedagogical and Educational Sciences 2 carries 6 EC; mandatory Academic Skills A and B carry zero credits. Year three includes 30 EC of electives or minor study and an 18 EC empirical thesis.
components: Introduction to Pedagogical and Educational Sciences 1
Introduction to Pedagogical and Educational Sciences 2
Academic Skills A and B are also mandatory in year one. They carry zero credits. Students must also attend nine scientific colloquium presentations during the bachelor.
Attend Descriptive Statistics before Testing and Measurement. Research methods and statistics provide its foundation.
Lifelong Learning: Personal, Organisational and Societal Perspectives
The Future of Learning and Technology
Pass Descriptive Statistics before Inferential Statistics.
Pass Descriptive Statistics and Testing and Measurement before this research-practice course.
Educational Sciences students must pass Organisation of Learning and Education before this consultancy project with external organisations.
Empirical Bachelor’s Thesis in Educational Sciences

Complete all first- and second-year requirements before starting, with an exception for one of six specified second-year subject courses. The thesis involves empirical research and individual written and oral reporting.

Choose related electives or a minor for 30 EC. First-year electives require permission unless they form part of a completed minor. Language-skills courses are excluded, and courses outside the faculty require Examination Board approval.

alternatives.label: Learning, development & educational research
alternatives.concept: Study learning across the lifespan and the social conditions that shape it. Combine developmental and social psychology, cognitive research, educational prevention and community speaking with qualitative inquiry and statistical evidence.
alternatives.labelReason: Developmental and social psychology, cognitive inquiry, prevention and research methods support study of learning and its social context.
progression: Brain & Behavior precedes cognitive, language and developmental study. Research Methods & Statistics prepares for advanced survey research, while comparative politics precedes policy analysis.

alternatives.label: Cognition, data & learning technology
alternatives.concept: Explore cognitive processes and technologies relevant to learning. Study attention, memory, language and development alongside programming, data analysis, machine learning and the ethical use of AI.
alternatives.labelReason: Cognitive development and language inquiry combine with programming, data analysis and AI ethics to examine tools and evidence relevant to digital learning.
alternatives.distinctness: This option develops computing and quantitative modelling alongside cognition. The closest option gives more weight to social inquiry, public policy and community education.
progression: Brain & Behavior prepares for cognition and psycholinguistics. Programming and data science precede advanced algorithms and machine learning, while mathematical methods precedes linear algebra and neural networks.

alternatives.label: Workplace development, leadership & innovation
alternatives.concept: Study how people develop and work together in organisations. Combine leadership, adult development, communication and research with digital strategy and data analysis to investigate organisational change.
alternatives.labelReason: Organisational psychology, adult development and research support inquiry into leadership and workplace change, with digital strategy and data analysis.
alternatives.distinctness: Organisational behaviour, leadership and digital strategy distinguish this option. It gives less weight to childhood education and public policy than the closest option.
progression: Research methods precede organisational psychology, negotiation and survey research. Brain & Behavior prepares for lifespan development and evidence synthesis. Data science precedes machine learning and business foundations precedes digital strategy.

selection.assessment: Three options address learning and development through social and educational research, cognition and learning technology, or workplace development and organisational change. Each maintains a different substantive emphasis.

blocks: Both introduce empirical research design, measurement and analysis.
Both teach qualitative research design, data collection and interpretation. UvA focuses on educational questions.
Both develop statistical skills for social or behavioural research. UCR also applies multivariable models.
Both consider development and learning. UCR studies development across life, while UvA introduces pedagogical and educational science.
Both use ethical reasoning and argument. UvA focuses specifically on educational ideals and rights.
Both study policy decisions and processes. UCR uses a general policy case, while UvA studies the education system.
Both examine inequality and social institutions. UCR includes education among its social contexts, while UvA studies educational systems in depth.
Both use economic reasoning to study public investment and social outcomes. UCR includes education spending among its applications.
Both develop empirical research through practical work. UCR uses surveys about leadership and social experience, while UvA studies education.
Both study organisations, people and change. UvA applies organisational theory to learning and education.

notes.text: UvA develops a sequence in learning theory, curriculum, instruction, assessment and educational research. UCR offers related study in psychology, social inquiry, computing and organisations, with different emphases across its options.

audience.programmeDescription: Educational Sciences at the University of Amsterdam studies how people learn and how education can improve. Students examine learning environments, educational organisations and policy, and develop skills in educational research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in learning and development, cognition and technology, or workplace development and leadership. UvA provides dedicated study of curriculum, instruction and educational assessment, followed by an 18 EC empirical thesis.
